final: WITH rating_averages AS (SELECT rating, AVG(length) AS avg_running_time, AVG(rental_rate / NULLIF(rental_duration, 0)) AS avg_fee_per_day FROM film GROUP BY rating), overall_average AS (SELECT AVG(avg_fee_per_day) AS avg_fee_per_day FROM rating_averages) SELECT AVG(r.avg_running_time), AVG(r.avg_fee_per_day), AVG(r.avg_fee_per_day - o.avg_fee_per_day) FROM rating_averages AS r CROSS JOIN overall_average AS o WHERE o.avg_fee_per_day IS NOT NULL AND r.avg_fee_per_day > o.avg_fee_per_day
